arm_selection.candidate: the sole experimental arm advanced by the registered screen
arm_selection.rule: Select the candidate only if it passes the same matched-seed gate on the full runs; otherwise select E0.

checkpoint_selection.rule: Within the selected arm, choose the seed minimizing L1 distance to the three-seed medians of exact-set accuracy and evidence recall; break ties by ascending seed.
checkpoint_selection.rationale: Use a representative finalist rather than cherry-picking the best development seed.
